  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:

#   --mem=20000
#   --job-name="road_detector"
#   --output=srun.out
#   --mail-user=joergen.rosager@gmail.com
#   --mail-type=ALL

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --gpus=1 \
  --time=5h \
  --queue=GPUQ \
  bash -lc '

exec >srun.out 2>&1

You MUST not make up directives that do not exist.
